answer: The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it. Every applicant faces the same trial, Dollmaker puppet proof counted beside the puppet theater, and every verdict reads the same way: each puppet is a tally of painted faces weighed beside the workshop stamp. Forge once and the fine is 2 times the stake, so a 193 POA proof becomes a 2x wound. A summit can be painted, a velvet can be borrowed, but a canyon must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
